breve: Represents the input shader parameter within the visual shader graph.
descricao: Gives access to input variables (built-ins) available for the shader. See the shading reference for the list of available built-ins for each shader type (check Tutorials section for link).

metodos.desc: Returns a translated name of the current constant in the Godot Shader Language. E.g. "ALBEDO" if the 'input_name' equal to "albedo".

propriedades.desc: One of the several input constants in lower-case style like: "vertex" (VERTEX) or "point_size" (POINT_SIZE).

sinais.desc: Emitted when input is changed via 'input_name'.
